Title: Probius Hotfix Patch #1
Subtitle: === Heroes: Gall ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Varian's Twin Blades of Fury Ability description in the Shop could appear truncated when using non-English versions of the game client in Windowed or Fullscreen mode.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Prevented Twisting Nether from being cast while in Molten Block form after learning the Shifting Nether Talent.

=== Heroes: Kharazim ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause a slight delay between Ability casts after shift-queuing Radiant Dash.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that removed all Mana Cost and Cooldown details from Zeratul's Ability tooltips.
